title: Identity & Access Management Expert II
full_description:
Identity & Access Management
Makati City, Philippines
IAM RSO-GHR/Identity and Access Management Expert II
ING is looking to recruit an Identity and Access management Expert for HR Assets (NL and Global) within the People Services domain.
If you take the initiative to help colleagues get a step ahead in life and in their careers. If the Orange Code is part of your DNA and if you would like to help the business to continue to develop every day, HR is the department within ING where you can put your talents to good use. Within our Human Resources organization, People Services creates a unique Employee Experience, continuously improves the customer experience, and works closely with the HR Centers of Expertise and HR Business Partners.
People Services handles questions and requests from employees and managers/leads from end to end in self-managing autonomous teams. This takes place with a high degree of customer focus, which enables us to create a ‘WOW’ experience.
The Identity and Access Management Expert for HR oversees the creation of one digital identity per individual, by defining and managing the roles and access privileges of individual network users and the circumstances in which users are granted or denied those privileges. Maintains, modifies and monitors this identity through changes in the user's circumstances.
Global Job Architecture – Job profile.
Job Profile Name        Identity and Access Management Expert II
Implement required digital identity and access measures, monitoring performance to notify experts of any problems.
Provide support and guidance on executing IAM and achieving and maintaining compliance
Facilitate business process owners and asset owners in Identity and Assess management related changes
Support IAM Key Control Owners in testing and monitor IAM related high-risk iRisk Key Control Test findings and other findings
Create SOLL and SOLL – Ist comparisons according to the regulatory necessity for the different assets.
Improve IAM by implementing the IAM Target Operating Model and liase with Global IAM on best practices and lessons learned
Advise on role creation, maintenance and deletion based on requirements from business owners, operational line managers, role owners and asset owners and in accordance with the user access model towards CoE IAM Market Leaders and Global
Administer and maintain role data model and roles in IAM tooling (e.g. ETL).
Monitor and enforce adherence to IAM processes and user access model (e.g. monitoring the timely execution of management reviews of user access rights).
Who are we looking for?You have a background in Identity Access Management and/or User Access Management
Understanding of Non-Financial Risk processes is a pre.
Experience and Knowledge
University education (first degree)
At least 2 years relevant working experience
Knowledge of IAM policies and standards
Experience with IAM processes and tooling
We are looking for the following competencies
Excellent English communication skills and ability to craft recommendations into the business language of the relevant stakeholders
The ability to speak confidently on technical subjects and system functional and non-functional configuration, managing a large and complex stakeholder map
A high degree of personal motivation, resilience and the ability to work in a high-pressure environment
Results Orientation as evidenced by a track record of delivering solutions which routinely exceed the business process expectations.
HR People Services is a challenging work environment with extensive, innovative developments with its close link to for example the HR Unite program but also running the bank and keeping assets safe and compliant according to the Identity and access managements standards. Staff who want to grow along with us will be given plenty of opportunities for their own initiatives and development.
Education & development
A very challenging (and international) environment
